episodes.title: Life's a Bitch and Then You Die
episodes.summary: Time's running out for senior BFFs Erika and Gia to live their best high school lives. A house party feels like a last chance — and final destination.

episodes.title: Resting Bitch Face
episodes.summary: Life as a dead person is a lot. Erika needs the facts but must pee first. Can she get solid spiritual advice from teens who see signs in pizzas?

episodes.title: Payback's a Bitch
episodes.summary: After ghosting Jake C., Erika needs to deal with her unfinished business. With promposals and paranormal activity in the air, the end is near. Maybe.

episodes.title: Bitch Slapped
episodes.summary: Kissing away unfinished business can be fun, but questions remain. Prom looms, but Erika will have to ask fast. In the excitement, Gia feels unseen.

episodes.title: Fake Bitch
episodes.summary: Word gets out: Erika's cool, not chill — and the queen of Parkway. But the pressure's on as the temp rises, frenemies square off, and a troll surfaces.

episodes.title: Who Dat Bitch?
episodes.summary: Life after death has never been so — popular. Gia confronts Erika and connects with Gavin. All hell breaks out when BFFs turn and the truth emerges.

episodes.title: Bad Bitch
episodes.summary: YOLO — or do you only live twice? Two besties get real while confessions fly. Old footage and a new hashtag threaten Erika's fame.

episodes.title: Bitch, Bye
episodes.summary: The afterlife comes calling. A will scribbled on a Forever 21 receipt, a hoped-for prom date, lava lamps: the power of friendship must shine through.
